import requests

# Let's check why Ionone is associated with CID 19167 in PubChem depositor records
url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/19167/sids/JSON"
sids = requests.get(url).json()['InformationList']['Information'][0]['SID']
print(f"Number of SIDs: {len(sids)}")
print(f"First 10 SIDs: {sids[:10]}")

for sid in sids[:10]:
    sid_url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sid/{sid}/summary/JSON"
    res = requests.get(sid_url).json()
    source = res['SourceList']['SourceName']
    print(f"SID {sid}: {source}")

for sid in sids:
    syn_url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sid/{sid}/synonyms/JSON"
    res = requests.get(syn_url)
    if res.status_code == 200:
        data = res.json()
        syns = data['InformationList']['Information'][0].get('Synonym', [])
        if any('ionone' in s.lower() for s in syns):
            print(f"SID {sid} has ionone! Synonyms: {syns}")
